recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up studio portrait of a man with voluminous auburn hair and a full beard, wearing a blue denim shirt and white overalls. The subject is posed with arms crossed in the foreground, set against a flat, muted blue-gray background. The composition is topped with a stylized, custom-lettered script logo in pale yellow.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm auburn hair tones contrasting against a cool blue-gray background
Textured denim and skin tones against a smooth, matte backdrop
Horizontal weight of the crossed arms grounding the verticality of the head
coreInvariants: Soft, diffuse studio lighting with gentle facial shadows
Muted, desaturated color palette typical of 1970s film stock
Upper-right placement of a thin-stroke script logo

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium close-up; head occupies the upper middle third, arms occupy the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bridge of the nose, forming the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the crossed arms, then sweeps up to the top-right logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space in the upper corners, particularly the top left, to balance the logo on the right.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with medium-high value; no deep blacks or pure whites.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Script with high-ascenders and underlining flourishes
letterConstructionRules: Extended horizontal underlines that integrate with the letterforms
Interlocking or overlapping characters in the center of words
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'M' with sharp peaks and a descending tail that turns into an underline
Lowercase 'y' with a looped tail that doubles back under the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stand-alone custom script; no secondary typeface used.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule/underline integrated into the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the era's preference for thin, elegant, custom-drawn nameplates.
Captures the uniform stroke width and sharp angles.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a man with thick, feathered auburn hair and a full beard, wearing a blue denim button-down shirt and white overall straps. He is leaning forward with his forearms crossed in the foreground. The lighting is soft and even. The background is a solid, slightly textured blue-gray. The overall image has a 1970s film grain and color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a custom thin-line script logo in the top right corner in a pale yellow color. The script should feature sharp ascenders and a long horizontal underline that extends from the first letter to the end of the word.

verificationChecks: Is the hair color a warm auburn?
Is the background a muted blue-gray?
Is the typography a thin, monoline script in the top right?
Does the image have a soft, vintage film quality?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the yellow in the logo
Grain level of the film effect
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Exact wording of the original text
Any specific record label logos or catalog numbers
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the arms in the foreground are not overly distorted.
Confirm the script logo does not overlap the subject's head.
Check that the color temperature remains warm in the skin/hair and cool in the background.
Verify the monolinear weight of the custom text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + 70s Film Grade + Muted Blue/Auburn Palette + Top-Right Monoline Script Logo
